translation.name: Mushog Testamento
translation.englishName: Huamalíes-Dos de Mayo Huánuco Quechua NT

content: Runacuna lutancunata yarpar jusayog ricacuyashganpita Jesucristo yachasishgan
Juc cutimi Jerusalenpita aywar fariseucuna y Moisés guelgashgan leycunata yachasegcuna Jesús cagman chäyargan.
Saychömi Jesuspa discïpuluncuna maquinta mana maylacuylapa micuycagta ricar paycuna jamuräyargan.
Fariseucuna y Israel mayincunaga unay runacunapa costumbrincunata cumplirmi manarä micur maquintarä maylacuyag limpio caycaptinpis.

Sayno costumbricunata cumplirmi pusilluncunatapis, plätuncunatapis, mancancunatapis, [y catrincunatapis] maylagrä limpio caycaptinpis. Saynömi rantipacuyashganpita cutirpis maquinta manarä maylacorga jamacuyagsu.

Saymi fariseucunawan Moisés guelgashgan leycunata yachaseg runacuna Jesusta tapuyargan: “¿Imanirtä discïpuluyquicuna unay runacunapa costumbrincunata mana cäsur micuyänanpä maquincunata maylacuyansu?”
Sayno niyaptinmi Jesús nergan: “¡Ishcay cära runacuna! Gamcuna sayno cayänayquipä cashganta musyarmi Santu Espíritu profëta Isaiasta tantyasergan. Saymi pay cayno guelgargan:

content.text: ‘Cay runacunaga janan shongulami: “Tayta Dios, Tayta Dios” nicäyäman.
Saynöpis manami lapan shongunwansu nogata chasquicayäman.
Paycunaga wilacuynëta yachasiyänanpa trucanga runacunapa costumbrilantami yachaycäsiyan.

content: Mastapis Jesús nergan: “Isaías nishgannölami gamcunapis Tayta Diosninsipa leynincunata cäsucuycäyanquisu. Cäsucunayquipa trucanga runacunapa costumbrincunalatami cumpliycäyanqui. [Saymi wichicunatapis pusillucunatapis y más waquintapis maylanquirä.]
Moisés guelgashganchöga caynömi nican:

content.text: Pipis mamanta o taytanta maldicionag cäga wanusish casun.’

content: Mamayquitawan taytayquita ali ricayänayquipä nicaptinpis gamcunaga manami yanapaycäyanquisu. Saymi runacunata yachaycäsiyanqui: ‘Tayta Dioslapämi imaycäpis caycan’ nerga mamantawan taytanta manana yanapänanpä.
Sayno yachasirmi gamcunaga Tayta Diosninsipa palabranta manacagman churaycäyanqui. Saynölami imatapis gamcunaga quiquiqui yarpäyashgalayquita ruraycäyanqui.”
Nircurnami runacunata gayaycur Jesús nergan: “Cay nishgäcunata lapayqui shumag tantyacuyay.
Manami imatapis micushganpitasu pipis jusayog ricacun, sinöga shonguncho mana alita yarpashganpitami.
[Nishgäta wiyag cäga shumag tantyacuyay.]”
Saysica runacuna saycho captinmi paycunapita witicushpan juc wayiman discïpuluncunawan Jesús aywargan. Saychönami discïpuluncuna ruwacuyargan yachasishgancunata tantyasinanpä.

Saymi Jesús nergan: “¿Gamcunapis manacu tantyayanquirä? ¿Manacu runa imata micushganpis päsagla caycan? Saymi micushganpitasu runaga jusayog ricacun, sinöga shonguncho lutancunata yarpashganpitami.” Jesús sayno nergan ima micuypis micunansipä ali cashganta tantyasishpanmi. Nircur mastapis Jesús nergan:
“Shonguncho lutancunata yarpachacurmi adulteriucho cayan, runacuna chinëru cayan, warmicunapis waynäcuyan, wanusinacuyan,
suwacuyan, wachacash cayan, lulacuyan, chiquinacuyan, jucpa washanta rimayan, yachag-tucuyan y luta jusalicuyan.
Lapan say mana ali ruraycunaga shonguncho lutanta yarpashganpitami caycan. Saynöpami runacuna jusayog ricacuyan.”
Mana Israel warmi Jesucristuman yäracushgan

Saypita Jesús aywargan Sirofenicia nacioncho cag Tiro marcapa. Sayman chashganta runacuna mana musyayänanpämi pipis mana ricayla juc wayiman posädacorgan. Sayno captinpis juc warmi musyargan Jesús sayman chashganta. Paypa wawantami gueshyawan supay nacaycäsergan. Saymi Jesús cagman aywaycur paypa puntanman gongurpacuycur ruwacorgan wawanpita supayta gargunanpä. Say warmega manami Israel warmisu cargan, sinöga jinan Sirofenicia nacionpitami cargan.
Sayno ruwacuptinmi Jesús nergan: “Puntataga yanapäshä Israel mayëcunatarämi. Gamcunata yanapaptëga canman wamracunapa tantanta guechurir algucunata jitapaycognömi.”
Sayno niptin warmi nergan: “Au, taytay. Sayno captinpis wamracuna shicwapacuyashgantami algucunapis micuyan.”
Sayno niptin Jesús nergan: “Sayno nicanqui rasunpaypa yäracamashpayquimi. Sayno yäracamashgayquipitami wawayquita nacaseg supay yargushgana caycan. Cananga wayiquipa cushish cuticuy.”
Sayno niptin wayinman cutirmi wamranta tarergan cachacashgana cämancho caycagta. Wamrata gueshyaseg supayga yargucushganami cash.
Upa runata Jesucristo aliyäsishgan
Tiro marcapitanami Jesús päsargan Sidón marcapa. Saypita cutirnami Galilea gocha cuchunpa päsar chargan Decápolis provinciaman.
Saycho caycaptinmi apayargan mana wiyag ni mana parlag runata. Chaycasirna Jesusta ruwayargan say upata aliyäsinanpä.
Sauraga quiquilanta jucläman pusharcur upapa rinrinman dëdunta Jesús jatergan. Nircur togayninwan dëdunta ushmarcasirmi upapa galluntapis yataycorgan.
Sayno rurarcurna jämayta cacharcur ciëluta ricärir: “¡Efata!” nergan. (“Efata” ninanga caycan “¡Quichacay!” ninanmi.)
Sayno niptinmi jinan höra upapa rinrin wiyargan y shiminpis pashtarganna.
Sayno aliyarcasirmi saycho caycag runacunata Jesús nergan aliyäsishganta pitapis mana wilapänanpä. Sayno nicaptinpis pï-maytami wilapäyargan upata Jesús aliyäsishganta.

Milagruta Jesús rurashganpita fiyupa cushicur may-saychöpis tincushgan runacunata niyargan: “¡Imaycatapis Jesusga ruraycun segaypa espantaypämi! ¡Cananga upacunapis wiyayannami y mana parlagcunapis parlayannami!”
